weather.tip: Clear and cool right now, but with a 41% rain chance later and yesterday's storms having paralysed traffic and blocked a rail route, it's worth carrying a light umbrella and padding your commute time today.

around.headline: Counterfeit medicine racket busted, found to have supplied 100+ Bengaluru pharmacies
around.summary: A healthcare firm owner was arrested and a large stock of counterfeit medicines seized after a racket was found to have supplied fake drugs to over 100 Bengaluru pharmacies and hospitals, with Karnataka now considering handing the probe to the CBI, per The Times of India and Bangalore Mirror. Buy medicines only from pharmacies you trust and ask for a proper bill, especially for critical or long-term medication.
around.source: The Times of India, Bangalore Mirror

around.headline: Fake IAF officer promises job, cheats man of gold chain
around.summary: A man posing as an Indian Air Force officer promised a job and cheated a Bengaluru resident out of a gold chain, per The Times of India. Any government or defence job offer that asks for cash, gold, or a "fee" upfront should be verified through the official recruitment channel first.

around.headline: Bengaluru woman's phone number leaked on dark web, flooded with harassing messages
around.summary: A Bengaluru woman's phone number surfaced on the dark web and she has since been flooded with sexually explicit messages from strangers, per The Times of India. If this happens to you, report it at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930, block and screenshot each sender for evidence, and avoid replying or posting your number publicly.

around.headline: Heavy rain and gusty winds disrupt city traffic and rail after a dry spell
around.summary: Heavy rain and gusty winds after a prolonged dry spell paralysed traffic in several parts of Bengaluru and caught commuters off guard, per The Hindu and Deccan Herald; separately, a fallen tree blocked the Talaguppa-Bengaluru rail route, stranding hundreds of passengers for about four hours, per The Times of India. Build in extra travel time and check train status before heading out if the rain continues.
around.source: The Hindu, The Times of India

around.headline: Namma Metro Pink Line phase 1 set to open
around.summary: Bengaluru's Pink Line phase 1 is set to open, with commuters weighing in on what to expect, per The Federal, alongside a separate look at what the newly announced 45km Phase III expansion will mean longer-term, per The Times of India. If you're near the Pink Line corridor, it's worth factoring the new route into your commute once it opens.
around.source: The Federal, The Times of India

around.headline: Karnataka plans global convention hub on 48-acre KTPO land in Whitefield
around.summary: Karnataka has announced plans to develop the 48-acre KTPO site in Whitefield into a convention and exhibition hub, per The Times of India and The Economic Times. Expect construction activity and possible traffic changes around Whitefield's KTPO area as the project progresses.
around.source: The Times of India, The Economic Times

around.headline: India's UPI ends fully-free era with a fee on large merchant payments
around.summary: India's UPI system has ended its fully free era, with a new fee now applying to large merchant payments, per Reuters. Small, everyday UPI payments are unaffected, but it's worth checking with the merchant if you're making a big-ticket purchase by UPI.

events.name: Ganesh Chaturthi immersion processions continue citywide
events.note: Devotees continue to throng temples and lakes for Gauri-Ganesh immersions, with almost 2 lakh idols already immersed on the first day, per Deccan Chronicle, India Today and The Times of India. Expect heavy crowds and slow traffic near lakes and procession routes through the week.
events.source: The Times of India, India Today

events.name: Lace up for lakes
events.note: A walking/running event centred on Bengaluru's lakes, per Deccan Herald — a straightforward one to join if you enjoy the lakefront and want a reason to get moving.

events.name: Electronics Manufacturing Exhibition (Electronica Bengaluru 2026)
events.note: Bengaluru hosts a major electronics manufacturing exhibition this week, per The Covai Mail. It's an industry trade show rather than a public festival, so it'll mainly interest those in electronics/manufacturing fields, but exhibitor halls are typically open to visitors who register.

street_smart.title: Your phone number ends up leaked online — like a Bengaluru woman's did this week — and strangers start flooding your WhatsApp with unwanted, sexually explicit messages and calls from unknown numbers. What's the smartest first move?
street_smart.based_on: The Times of India, Sept 15 — a Bengaluru woman's phone number surfaced on the dark web and she has since been flooded with sexually explicit messages from strangers. This leaked-number/harassment-response mechanism hasn't been used as a street-smart scenario in the last three weeks.
street_smart.situation: The messages keep coming through the day, some from new numbers every few hours, and you don't know how your number got out or who's behind it.

choices.text: Report it immediately at cybercrime.gov.in or by calling 1930, save screenshots of the messages and sender numbers as evidence, then block and report each sender on WhatsApp without replying to any of them.
choices.feedback: Correct. An official report creates a case trail that can help trace the source or hold a platform accountable if it escalates, and blocking/reporting without replying denies harassers any reaction to feed off — all while your evidence stays intact.

choices.text: Reply firmly telling the senders to stop and to remove your number, and post about the harassment in a public Bengaluru community group so others are warned.
choices.feedback: This is the trap. Replying confirms the number is active and being read, which tends to invite more messages, not fewer; and posting your number in a public group — even to complain — exposes it to an even wider audience, compounding the original leak.

choices.text: Silently block every number as the messages arrive and otherwise ignore it, without filing any official report.
choices.feedback: Risky. Blocking cuts the daily annoyance but does nothing to trace the source, stop the leak from being used elsewhere, or protect you if the messages escalate into threats — without a report, there's no record if you need one later.

choices.text: Get a new SIM with a new number right away to escape the harassment.
choices.feedback: Risky as a first move. It's disruptive to banking logins, contacts and apps tied to the old number, doesn't address wherever your number leaked from, and if the old SIM isn't properly deactivated it can still be a target for SIM-swap fraud.

takeaways: Report harassment like this at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930 — an official complaint matters even if you also block the senders yourself.
Never engage or reply to unknown harassers — silence plus block-and-report is safer than confrontation, which can invite more messages.
Avoid posting your number publicly even to warn others or complain about a leak; share evidence privately with the police or platform instead.

quiz.question: A counterfeit medicine racket busted in Bengaluru this week was found to have supplied fake drugs to how many pharmacies, per Bangalore Mirror?
quiz.why: The scale of the racket is why Karnataka is now considering handing the probe over to the CBI.

quiz.question: What stranded hundreds of passengers on the Talaguppa-Bengaluru train route this week, per The Times of India?
options: A fallen tree on the track
quiz.why: The disruption came the same day heavy rain and gusty winds after a prolonged dry spell paralysed road traffic across the city too.

quiz.question: According to Reuters, what changed for India's UPI payment system this week?
options: A fee now applies to large merchant payments, ending its fully free era
It became available only to businesses
quiz.why: Small, everyday UPI payments remain unaffected — the fee targets high-value merchant transactions specifically.

quiz.question: Which number can you call in India to report a cybercrime, such as online harassment or a financial scam?
quiz.why: 1930 is the national cybercrime helpline; 100 and 112 are for general police emergencies, and 108 is for medical/ambulance emergencies.

quiz.question: Which gas makes up the largest share of Earth's atmosphere by volume?
quiz.why: Nitrogen makes up about 78% of the atmosphere, with oxygen a distant second at roughly 21%.
